name: WRSA 66th Annual Meeting (2027)
conf_dates_note: Opening plenary and welcome reception Sunday 14 Feb; paper sessions Monday-Wednesday 15-17 Feb
deadline_note: Stated as 'October 15, 2026 (extended to November 30, 2026)'. A complete version is needed by 31 December 2026. Tiebout Prize hard deadline 15 Oct 2026 (extended to 31 Oct 2026).
submission_requirements: Full papers only (draft acceptable), uploaded through a free WRSA website account; program invitations are issued only on full papers, not abstracts or outlines. All presenters are expected to discuss a paper and/or chair a session. Panel sessions: contact the executive director. Travel grant (partial hotel) for graduate students and early-career scholars: tick the box when submitting.
registration_fee: Early (before 9 Jan 2027) / late: regular USD 690 / 790 (not staying at the conference hotel) or USD 390 / 490 (staying at the hotel); students USD 360 / 410 (not staying) or USD 180 / 230 (staying); member + partner USD 900 / 1,000 (USD 600 / 700 staying). Registration includes 2027 WRSA membership.
membership_required: No separate dues; conference registration includes 2027 WRSA membership
